ХХХ: Lying here now, watching a movie, the doorbell rings. Not expecting anyone. I open the inner door, ask: who? By the door lies some bag, stands a young lad:
- We, he says, go around from an organization, notifying residents.
- Well notify, I say, I'm listening.
- No, he says, you open up, I'm not interested in talking to your door.
- Yes, please, I answer, have a good day.
He sulked. the smile disappeared.
- After six they'll drop a paper in your mailbox, read it there.
He's notifying, from an organization, with a bag, on March 7th, yeah.

УУУ: Once Nastya and I are sitting in our kitchen, drinking tea. Not expecting anyone. Doorbell.
A woman stands there:
- We, she says, exterminated cockroaches in your building entrance. So they don't run into your apartment, you need to treat your ventilation grilles. If you don't have anything, you can buy it from me.
- We have some, we answer, and also think - yeah yeah, sure sure.
Especially since our dad sealed all the ventilation with fine mesh.
We keep sitting. And suddenly, like, crazed cockroaches ran at us all over the wall. Turns out the corner of the mesh in the kitchen came unstuck, and they rushed to us for tea. We barely caught them all.
So do go to the mailbox after six after all. Just in case.
